description: Header file defining the NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid class, which manages thread-safe notifications of network changes on Android, including connection type, cost, bandwidth, and network connectivity events. It also declares the nested Observer interface for receiving updates.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid
classes.description: Manages thread-safe notifications of network state changes on Android, including observer registration, notification handling, and querying current network status.

classes.name: NetworkChangeNotifierDelegateAndroid::Observer
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to receive network change notifications from the delegate.

methods.name: NotifyConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to update connection type and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyConnectionCostChanged
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to update connection cost and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyMaxBandwidthChanged
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to update max bandwidth and notify observers.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkConnect
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to indicate a network connection event.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkSoonToDisconnect
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to indicate a network will disconnect soon.

methods.name: NotifyOfNetworkDisconnect
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to indicate a network disconnection.

methods.name: NotifyPurgeActiveNetworkList
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to update active network list.

methods.name: NotifyOfDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Called from Java on JNI thread to indicate default network is active.

methods.name: RegisterObserver
methods.description: Registers an observer for network change notifications.

methods.name: UnregisterObserver
methods.description: Unregisters an observer from network change notifications.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserverRemoved
methods.description: Notifies delegate that a default network active observer was removed.

methods.name: DefaultNetworkActiveObserverAdded
methods.description: Notifies delegate that a default network active observer was added.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionCost
methods.description: Returns the current connection cost.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the current connection type.

methods.name: GetCurrentMaxBandwidthAndConnectionType
methods.description: Retrieves current max bandwidth and connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkConnectionType
methods.description: Returns connection type for a given network handle.

methods.name: GetCurrentDefaultNetwork
methods.description: Returns the current default network handle.

methods.name: GetCurrentlyConnectedNetworks
methods.description: Fills a list with currently connected networks.

methods.name: IsDefaultNetworkActive
methods.description: Returns whether the default network is active.

methods.name: GetCurrentConnectionSubtype
methods.description: Returns current connection subtype; main thread only.

methods.name: RegisterNetworkCallbackFailed
methods.description: Indicates if network callback registration failed.

methods.name: EnableNetworkChangeNotifierAutoDetectForTest
methods.description: Enables auto-detect for testing purposes.
